derivation: probably from the base of G3735 (ὄρος);
def: right (as rising), i.e. (perpendicularly) erect (figuratively, honest), or (horizontally) level or direct

occurrences.text: Said with a loud voice, Stand upright on thy feet. And he leaped and walked.
And make straight paths for your feet, lest that which is lame be turned out of the way; but let it rather be healed.

source: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890) and Concise Dictionaries (1894), public domain; JSON by Open Scriptures (CC BY-SA).
